clue.text: Unforeseen problem mostly became wearisome, with outgoing leader booed

indicators.note: mostly means most but not all, so the snag word gives up its final letter
a leader who is outgoing is leaving, so the first letter of the word for wearisome goes

blocks.note: a catch is a hidden snag
to pall is to become tiresome

explanation.surface: A snag nearly wore someone out, and a departing boss got jeered on the way out.
explanation.walkthrough: CATC(h) loses its last letter and (p)ALLED its first, giving CATCALLED.
explanation.definitionFit: To catcall is to whistle or jeer derisively at someone, the same as booing them.

clue.text: How much you believe you can spend?

definitions.text: How much you believe you can spend?

blocks.clueFragment: How much you believe you can spend?

setter's reading: to believe is to give credit, and the bank sets the ceiling on what you may borrow and spend

explanation.definitionFit: A credit limit is the maximum a card or account holder is permitted to borrow and spend.

clue.text: Feature of bowling takes prize money, with a twist

explanation.definitionFit: Topspin is forward rotation a bowler or tennis player imparts to the ball, making it dip and kick.

clue.text: Felt bad, being unsuccessful in ousting leader

explanation.definitionFit: To ail is to be unwell, so having ailed is having felt poorly or sick.

clue.text: Old dance is crazy subject for discussion

blocks.note: a motion is a proposal put before a meeting for debate

clue.text: Newspaper, note, blocking detective in police operation

blocks.note: a rag is a low-grade newspaper

explanation.definitionFit: A dragnet is a systematic sweep by police to catch suspects, named after a fishing net.

clue.text: Result of pig-shooting finally reported in online forum

indicators.note: finally points to the very last letter of the word that follows

blocks.note: shoot a wild pig and a bullet ends up in the boar

clue.text: Caledonia in a storm? It’s not precisely warm

clue.text: Demand and get lavatory emptied on the spot

the first and last letters of lavatory

clue.text: Negotiator, during legal sessions, beginning to edit record

explanation.definitionFit: An intermediary is a go-between who negotiates on behalf of two parties.

clue.text: Providing cover for group nearing retirement?

blocks.note: a band is a group of musicians or people

clue.text: Some sibilance picked up in “suspect’s story”

clue.text: They reveal daughter is accepting second way to resolve trauma?

clue.text: Put out something evasive about Times page

clue.text: Cavalry not deployed to arrest one visionary

blocks.note: I is the Roman numeral one

clue.text: Loves to embrace a measure of hardness?

clue.text: Baggage French friend brought back includes section of building

clue.text: Jaunty clarinet air affecting many people

explanation.definitionFit: Interracial means involving or between different races, so it concerns several peoples at once.

clue.text: Image formed by etching? Left no copper in it

blocks.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.definitionFit: A linocut is a print made from a design carved into a block of linoleum, a kind of engraved picture.

clue.text: Church having disturbance involving a former military vehicle

clue.text: Works function edgy? Not very

clue.text: Puzzles returned unchanged, including snare

clue.text: Household official overturned difficulty or changed mood

blocks.note: to be in a jam is to be in difficulty

clue.text: Play having significant dealings with love?

clue.text: Sanctioned interrupting winner? It makes for an unpleasant atmosphere
